# Widget inventory: the demo path

23 screens, 626 widgets with a test id.

Generated by `python scripts/qa_widgets.py` from the code (every element with a `data-testid` on each screen of the demo path) and from `docs/design/stitch/INVENTORY.md` (screen ids). The roles, states and AI line of each screen are written in the script. A label column is empty when the visible text comes from data (a number, a name of a paper) or from a child component. This is the checklist for `e2e/demo-path.spec.ts` (recorded AI answers), `e2e/demo-path-ai-off.spec.ts` (AI off) and `docs/build/reports/QA-DEMO.md`.

Every widget must also meet the shared rules: a visible or accessible label; 44 px touch target (48 px primary buttons); disabled only with a reason on screen; an error message that says what happened and what to do; no raw code or stack trace; English, Hindi and Tamil text from `strings/`.
